alt: 一個人站在開闊草坡上，迎著微風舒展雙臂，微笑欣賞湖泊與遠山。
scene_prompt: An adult stands on a safe broad grassy hill overlooking a spacious blue lake and distant green mountains under an open pale blue sky. The person takes a relaxed deep breath, eyes softly closed, shoulders loose and arms slightly open, joyful peaceful smile. Gentle breeze moves hair and meadow grasses; broad open vista conveys a refreshed expansive happy mind. Natural landscape, simple strong silhouette, no vertigo or danger.
